name: ZEEL DESAI
bio:
Career Overview: Playing Style: A steady player with a solid serve and versatile groundstrokes, adept on hard courts.
Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Yet to play in a Grand Slam main draw.
Notable Achievements: ITF Titles: Won 3 ITF singles titles (2018 Egypt W15, 2022 Thailand W15, 2023 Gurugram W15) and 6 doubles titles. WTA Debut: Reached R2 at 2024 WTA 125 Mumbai Open, defeating Sapfo Sakellaridi. Billie Jean King Cup: 2-3 record for India since 2021 debut vs. Latvia. Biggest Win: Defeated World No. 372 Naho Sato at 2023 ITF W25 Gurugram.
Other Highlights: Runner-up at 2023 ITF W40 Bengaluru (lost to Shrivalli Bhamidipaty). Trains at Ahmedabad Racquets Academy. Aims for a Top 400 ranking.
Zeel is a consistent ITF contender pushing for a higher pro breakthrough.
